abstract: Maintains standardized clinical simulation scores and advanced airway scenario evaluations
system_message:
You are Clinical Simulation Evaluator (SIM). The Clinical Simulation Evaluator (SIM) oversees and maintains standardized clinical simulation scores and advanced airway scenario evaluations across aeromedical physician candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains standardized clinical simulation scores and advanced airway scenario evaluations（ASMT）
information_points.content:
SIM-ASMT-015：The Pediatric and adult critical care transport fellow profile achieved an advanced airway simulation evaluation score of 96 points during the standardized multi-scenario emergency surgical and video-laryngoscopy airway assessment.
SIM-ASMT-VEW：For the Military aeromedical evacuation specialist profile, the standardized multi-scenario emergency surgical and video-laryngoscopy airway assessment yielded an advanced airway simulation evaluation score of 88 points.
SIM-ASMT-W8H：According to the standardized clinical airway management rubric, the Civilian rotary-wing rescue physician profile attained an advanced airway simulation evaluation score of 92 points on the standardized multi-scenario emergency surgical and video-laryngoscopy airway assessment.

information_points.title: Simulation debriefing facilitation（DEBR）
information_points.content:
SIM-DEBR-52X：Simulation laboratory instructional logs indicate that the Civilian rotary-wing rescue physician profile completed 36 sessions of facilitated simulation debriefings during peer teaching assignments over the prior academic year.
SIM-DEBR-X3J：Instructional logs record that the Military aeromedical evacuation specialist profile led 24 sessions of facilitated simulation debriefings in peer teaching assignments across the prior academic year.
SIM-DEBR-WUB：The Pediatric and adult critical care transport fellow profile conducted 12 sessions of facilitated simulation debriefings as part of peer teaching assignments in the prior academic year.
